common.pdfNotReady: The PDF is not ready yet. Open this page again later.
common.pdfUnavailable: The PDF could not be opened just now. Try again in a few minutes.

receipt.cancelled: Cancelled on {date}. The school cancelled this receipt.
receipt.keep: Keep this receipt. It is the school's record of your payment.

dues.title: Fees due for {name}
dues.nothingDue: Nothing is due now. Thank you.
dues.payOnlineNote: You will go to Razorpay's page for the school's own account. The school sends your receipt after the payment.
dues.upiHow: Scan this QR with any UPI app and type the amount. Show the payment to the school office if they ask.
dues.paidAlready: Paid already? The school will send your receipt.
dues.noCard: This page never asks for card or bank details.

errors.choose: Tick at least one fee to pay.
errors.not_connected: Online payment is not available for this school now. Pay at the school office or by UPI.
errors.nothing_due: Nothing is due on the fees you ticked. Open this page again to see what is due now.
errors.too_many: Too many payment pages are open for this student. Ask the school office.
errors.limit: Too many payment tries from this link today. Try again tomorrow or ask the school office.
errors.failed: The payment page could not be opened. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.expired: This link has expired. Ask the school office for a new one.

paid.title: Payment
paid.thanks: Thank you. Your payment of {amount} was received.
paid.receipt: The school will send your receipt on WhatsApp.
paid.receiptReady: The school has made your receipt and will send it on WhatsApp.
paid.waiting: Waiting for Razorpay to confirm your payment of {amount}…
paid.waitingNote: This page checks again by itself. You can also close it: if you paid, the school will send your receipt.
paid.stillWaiting: Razorpay has not confirmed the payment yet. If money left your account, the school will send your receipt when it arrives.
paid.notPaid: This payment was not completed. Open the fees page to try again.
paid.unknown: We could not find this payment. If money left your account, the school will send your receipt.

optin.title: School messages on WhatsApp
optin.intro: These are the messages {school} sends you on WhatsApp.
optin.stoppedByYou: You stopped these by sending STOP.
optin.howToStop: To stop all messages, reply STOP to the school's WhatsApp message.
optin.howToJoin: To get messages you have not joined, ask the school office for a joining slip.
optin.saved: Saved. Messages and pages from the school will be in your choice.
optin.saveFailed: Your choice was not saved. Try again in a few minutes.
